description: Hevy is a workout tracking and fitness logging service. Its public API lets users access and manage workout, routine, exercise template, routine folder, exercise history, and body measurement data.
summary: hevy.com exposes one documented HTTP API at https://api.hevyapp.com, authenticated with a user-generated Hevy API key sent in the `api-key` header; no first-party GraphQL, MCP server, or CLI were found.
